blocks.html: Whereupon the Court, the better to assure itself, orders that the principal witnesses who had affirmed the prisoner to be Martin Guerre should come in person, and particularly the four sisters and brothers-in-law of the said Martin, together with the uncle, brothers and certain kinsfolk of the said [du] Tilh, so that [the two men] might be exhibited to them severally and together, and they might choose from them the one whom they recognised to be truly Martin Guerre. All the said witnesses come, save the brothers of the said du Tilh, who, by multiplication of penalties, letters and commands, could not be forced to come and depose against their brother.
